name: wayback (OpenWayback / Internet Archive)
what_it_holds: Internet Archive's own Wayback Machine server implementation, including `wayback-cdx-server` (the reference CDX query server), `wayback-core`, and `wayback-webapp`. 2,983 commits, 120 open issues, 18 open PRs.
why_useful: Reference implementation for the CDX API that both cdx_toolkit and waybackpack talk to; useful mainly as documentation of the CDX query surface (date-range, collapse, filter params) if we ever need to hand-roll a point-in-time Wayback pull for AirDNA/Airbnb press pages.
license: not stated in fetched content (historically Apache-2.0 via OpenWayback lineage)
themes: Common Crawl tooling: cdx-toolkit, warcio, host-level indexes, columnar index queries; datasets derived from Common Crawl for travel sites
why_all: Reference implementation for the CDX API that both cdx_toolkit and waybackpack talk to; useful mainly as documentation of the CDX query surface (date-range, collapse, filter params) if we ever need to hand-roll a point-in-time Wayback pull for AirDNA/Airbnb press pages.

name: cc-notebooks
what_it_holds: Jupyter notebooks demonstrating CC index analysis: domain coverage 2013-2019, character-set/MIME-type stats, a case study on internet-blocking effects visible in the 2019 Iran crawl, WARC exploration via AWS EMR, payload-truncation analysis, and Hugging Face access examples. Apache-2.0, 28 commits.
why_useful: Worked examples for pulling domain-level coverage metrics year-by-year, which is the template we'd reuse to build an airbnb.com / booking.com / vrbo.com domain-presence panel from the columnar index rather than writing that from scratch; low novelty on its own (no ABNB-specific data).
size_hint: notebook code only, no bundled dataset
themes: Common Crawl tooling: cdx-toolkit, warcio, host-level indexes, columnar index queries; datasets derived from Common Crawl for travel sites
why_all: Worked examples for pulling domain-level coverage metrics year-by-year, which is the template we'd reuse to build an airbnb.com / booking.com / vrbo.com domain-presence panel from the columnar index rather than writing that from scratch; low novelty on its own (no ABNB-specific data).

name: ckan-api-client
what_it_holds: Python client for the CKAN API (9 stars, BSD-2, updated Nov 2025). CKAN underlies many EU national/regional open-data portals (data.europa.eu harvested nodes, UK data.gov.uk, several Italian/Spanish regional portals) and some tourism-board data catalogs.
why_useful: Generic access method for EU/regional CKAN portals that could carry tourism-nights, STR-registration, or lodging-tax datasets outside what the team already has for Eurostat/INE Spain — could surface finer-grained regional/municipal series (gap 7 regional travel volume, gap 12 EU STR registration: Amsterdam, Berlin, Vienna, Lisbon RNAL, France).
themes: Open-data portal discovery: Socrata/CKAN/data.gov/EU data portal clients, dataset search tools, Google Dataset Search scrapers; city portals with STR datasets
why_all: Generic access method for EU/regional CKAN portals that could carry tourism-nights, STR-registration, or lodging-tax datasets outside what the team already has for Eurostat/INE Spain — could surface finer-grained regional/municipal series (gap 7 regional travel volume, gap 12 EU STR registration: Amsterdam, Berlin, Vienna, Lisbon RNAL, France).

name: datasette-socrata
what_it_holds: Datasette plugin (Simon Willison, Apache-2.0, 1 star, updated Jul 2025) that imports any Socrata dataset URL directly into a local Datasette/SQLite database for querying.
why_useful: Lightweight one-command way to snapshot a Socrata city dataset (e.g. a municipal STR registry or lodging-tax collection table) into a queryable local file, which is useful for point-in-time captures of city STR/permit portals mentioned in gap 12.

name: catalog-query
what_it_holds: Basic CKAN API query/extract functions with IOOS-specific extensions (1 star, MIT, updated Mar 2021). General-purpose CKAN dataset search/extract helper functions.
why_useful: Marginal: another CKAN query helper that could be adapted to search open-data catalogs (e.g. data.gov's CKAN backend) for STR, tourism, or lodging-tax datasets by keyword rather than browsing manually.
